title: Deposit rental bonds with the Territory
what: Deposit each rental bond received with the Territory, with a notice, before the prescribed period ends.

sources.title: Residential Tenancies Act 1997 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 23(3) (current republication (R84, from 26 November 2025; Residential Tenancies Act 1997 | Acts))
sources.quote: If the tenant pays the bond to the lessor and not to the lessor’s agent, the lessor must, before the prescribed period ends, deposit with the Territory— (a) the amount of the bond; and (b) a notice in accordance with section 25

reach.condition: if it lets residential premises and takes a rental bond
